proofs.text: Run the command with `--json` over a TypeScript file carrying a tautological test, an empty body and a real assertion; verify the three results read `tautology`, `no_assertion` and `pass`

rule_text: A JavaScript or TypeScript body asserting `expect(true).toBe(true)` is reported `tautology`, a body with no `expect(` call is reported `no_assertion`, and a body with a real assertion passes

tests.name: test_check_js_assertion_detection
